description: §7.3.3 / §18.7 (S479) — the boundaries of E-SCOPE-REDECLARE: distinct binders in one arm, the wildcard `_` repeated in one arm (`.Loaded(_, _)`, `<Twice(n, _)>`), and the same name bound by two different arms are all legal, in the value `match` and the block-form `<match>`.
rationale: §7.3.3 (S479): "The wildcard `_` binds nothing and may repeat; two arms may each bind the same name".
